text:
incident-bot: PAGER: multiple GPU prefill OOMs detected in us-west2-gpu-pool (gp4-32x). 5 container restarts in last 3m. alert: https://alerts.internal/7920001111

sre-jen: Oncall here, paging into thread. Seeing container restarts + node flaps in us-west2. Starting triage.

infra-alex: I can see nodes n-46..n-48 with process restarts, dmesg shows oom_killer invoked for process 'rwd-runtime'.

eng-oncall: Confirmed high prefill allocations from requests with large context windows (user-provided long prompts). Token distribution spike to ~80k tokens in some traces.

eng-mike: Posting a sample runtime error from pod rwd-runtime-5f7d:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:34Z ERROR runtime.prefill: cuda runtime error (2) : out of memory
  allocation failed: trying to allocate 24.0 GiB (GPU 0)
Container rwd-runtime-5f7d killed by SIGKILL
```

support-lina: Support note: error rate up for customers: cust-42 (chatbot) and cust-117 (doc-search). Both report failures on long queries starting ~02:10 UTC. Opening tickets.

sre-jen: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) reduce PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS for runtime, (2) enable prefix trimming for long requests, (3) route very-large-context requests to cold fallback or smaller model, (4) cordon problematic node if it keeps flapping. Applying change now.

eng-oncall: Applying env patch to deployments:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/rwd-runtime PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=32768 PREFILL_TRIM=true
kubectl rollout restart deploy/rwd-runtime
```

infra-alex: Restart initiated. Rolling restarts across 24 pods. Watch for eviction/unsched since this reduces peak mem usage.

sre-jen: Also adding a temporary router rule: route requests with estimated_token_count > 65k -> cold-model-1 (fallback). Patch pushed to edge routing config.

eng-mike: Pushed a lightweight prefill guard in the gateway to reject >100k tokens with 413 until we validate trims.

support-lina: Customer comms draft (short):
"We are investigating increased errors for long-context requests. We’ve applied mitigations to reduce immediate impact and will follow up with a timeline and root cause."

infra-alex: After restart, 22 pods healthy, 2 pods on node n-46 crash-looping. I cordoned n-46 to drain remaining pods -> moving traffic off it.

eng-oncall: Verified error rate back down to baseline for most tenants. cust-42 saw a spike of 6% failed requests for 12 minutes; cust-117 had intermittent timeouts. Logging all affected request IDs to the support tickets.

sre-jen: Escalation notes: possible memory fragmentation for long-seq KV cache prefill path. Follow-up action item for eng-runtime: investigate KV cache allocation and consider trimming/eviction heuristics.

eng-mike: Adding to backlog: autotrim on prefix + adaptive kv eviction. Will create RFC after hot mitigation.

support-lina: Will send proactive customer updates and include ETA: full monitoring for 2h, engineering follow-up tomorrow.

sre-jen: Handoff: I'm leaving a live on-call ticket with timeline, actions taken, logs attached. Oncall -> @eng-oncall will monitor for next 60m then escalate to infra if node reappears.

eng-oncall: ack :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards and traces. Set alert threshold lower (3 OOMs / 5m) while we validate.

incident-bot: NOTE: Post-incident checklist created: INCIDENT-7920001111. Action items: 1) root cause KV cache alloc path (eng-runtime), 2) keyboard safe limits in router (eng-oncall), 3) customer follow-ups (support).

sre-jen: Thanks all. Leaving a short runbook snippet in the incident doc for the night oncall: what to do if OOMs recur -> cordon node, enable cold-model routing, revert PREFILL_TRIM=false only after validation.

eng-oncall: Will follow up with metrics in 15m. If anything else surfaces I'll reopen thread.

support-lina: Ticket updates sent to cust-42 and cust-117. Template used: "We applied temporary routing and request limits to mitigate OOMs; we will follow up with a postmortem."

sre-jen: Closing active pager for now. Leaving incident in monitoring state.

eng-mike: Filing RFC and test harness for long-context scenarios tomorrow.

eng-oncall: last check: no new OOMs in 18m, nodes stable. Handing back to weekly rotation.
